g.text: (d) Total heat soaked by the shield

Model: 3-DOF point mass, US-76 density, Sutton–Graves convective heating only (radiative heating, significant above 10 km/s, omitted). LEO: 7.6 km/s, −1.35°, β = 610 kg/m², L/D 0.3, bank 55°. Lunar: 11.0 km/s, −6.0°,
β = 350 kg/m², L/D 0.27, simple bank-angle guidance. Entry interface 122 km. Illustrative, not flight trajectories.
